collection.description: A man is asked when he will become a father.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1) is asked when he will become a father. He likes children, but he is unsure he wants to raise one, and the question follows him through the village.

choices.label: Spend a Day Helping at the Nursery

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: His friends accept that he has not made up his mind.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One friend keeps pushing; he changes the subject.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They discuss their different hopes without making promises.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They discover a difficult incompatibility and need time.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: He enjoys the children and remains unsure about parenthood.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The exhausting day strengthens his preference for a childfree life.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: He feels freer to imagine a future of his own choosing.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: He still worries about disappointing someone he loves.
